headline: What is a water-sharing treaty, and why is it so hard to agree?
standfirst: Rivers do not stop at borders. Here is how countries try to share them — and why talks so often stall.
keyPoints: Many of the world’s big rivers cross several countries.
Treaties set out how much water each country can use.
Droughts and new dams put old agreements under strain.
